product: Ethan Lee Barrett public-work catalogue on povvo.github.io/povvo: a finder for about sixty repositories (v2 restyle)
audience: Recruiters, collaborators and curious developers arriving from GitHub on laptops and phones for a few minutes
decision_owner: Ethan Lee Barrett (direction drafted in this build; approval pending his review)
visual_thesis: Because the visitor meets sixty projects by one person and must feel both the size of the work and the singularity of each piece, set the catalogue as a campaign sheet printed under heat: a pale sun-bleached field holds the rack like a horizon, one hot glossy case stands in front of its own enormous condensed title, a dense dark cockpit holds the tracklist, and small protocol apparatus annotates the object, so that the first read is the object, the second the title and the quiet read the codes.
perceptual_goals: Orientation: one person's body of work; wordmark, protocol strip and count
Selection: the current case is the only hot object out of the rack and the only title on the field
Relation: edge rail ticks and tracklist rows mirror rack order
Interpretation: covers read as designed objects in one language with four layouts
Reward: the registration stamp, the drawn callout, the case opening into a feature spread

anti_targets.name: Festival neon
anti_targets.failure_signature: Every collision colour across the page as gradients or glow; dark page with neon type

anti_targets.name: Library calm
anti_targets.failure_signature: Warm stock, book serif titles, muted inks, nothing large on the stage (the v1 result)

anti_targets.name: Source cosplay
anti_targets.failure_signature: Anything recognisable as Flume, grandtao or greedy property: marks, cars, photographs, the orbital eye

anti_targets.name: Glitch theatre
anti_targets.failure_signature: Registration offsets, scanlines or noise on reading text, or effects that loop with hands off

anti_targets.name: Spec-Scan carry-over
anti_targets.failure_signature: Cyan instrument lines, Plex Mono, scanlines, the aperture P

routes.name: A. Heat Sheet
routes.governing_relationship: Object over title over field: one hot case stands in front of its giant condensed title on a pale heat field; a dark cockpit holds the dense list
routes.tradeoff: Fitting a giant title behind a moving 3D object needs a DOM layer under a transparent canvas and careful cut timing
routes.falsification_test: The giant title competes with the case at rest, or the cockpit reads as a generic dark sidebar

routes.name: B. Cockpit Night
routes.governing_relationship: Density dominates: the whole page is the dark petrol cockpit, cases glow as the only colour, the list is primary
routes.tradeoff: Loses the heat field and the quiet register; drifts toward the dark portfolio default
routes.falsification_test: Competitor reassignment: another developer's dark portfolio could ship it unchanged

routes.name: C. Monochrome Dossier
routes.governing_relationship: Order dominates: grandtao and editorialisated monochrome catalogue grid; cases in greys with one red; halftone specimens
routes.tradeoff: Coherent and restrained but loses Zawada's collision energy, which is what Ethan pointed at
routes.falsification_test: The reference the brief names is no longer visible in the result

signature_patterns.name: Type behind the object
signature_patterns.governing_relationship: The current title is set huge in condensed italic behind the extracted case, fitted to the stage width
signature_patterns.recurrence_rule: Exactly one title, always the current case, shown only when the rack has settled
signature_patterns.variation_rule: One or two lines by length; under reduced motion it swaps without the stamp
signature_patterns.failure_signature: Title over the case, two giant words, giant type in the cockpit

signature_patterns.name: The registration stamp
signature_patterns.governing_relationship: On settle the title arrives with a misregistered copy in the case colour, which registers within two frames
signature_patterns.recurrence_rule: Once per settle, on display type only
signature_patterns.variation_rule: Offset direction follows the turn direction
signature_patterns.failure_signature: Looping glitch, effects on reading text, effects on hover

signature_patterns.name: The callout
signature_patterns.governing_relationship: A hairline circle drawn around the extracted case's spine code with a leader to a mono label
signature_patterns.recurrence_rule: Only on the current case, only when settled, hidden when open
signature_patterns.variation_rule: Leader side flips on narrow screens
signature_patterns.failure_signature: Callouts on several objects or circles with nothing inside
